Change for the worse. When I began to use the Ambiance app I was pleasantly surprised by how often I used it and the benefits I gained in focus and relaxation alike. I am a Fabulous app user and I loved the way that Ambience integrated with Fabulous seamlessly. Loved it. 
Unfortunately, I don’t know whether it’s due to updates or a lack there of, but the integration feature is no more. In addition there seems to be a function that now automatically shuts off your sound after about 3 min. Not to mention the interface has always been clunky and as they add features and new sounds you have to dig to find your frequently selected sounds.
In a redesign, it would be nice if my frequently selected sounds were readily available or at least easily searchable.
Overall I’m grateful for the app and loved using it for a time. but I use it less and less

reviews.text:
High quality background sounds. I like the variety of tracks available to listen to. I like that there are both deep calming tracks as well as ones with a little more energy for during the day. The looping is relatively smooth, and the sound quality is high. I like to put on Nighttime Orchestra in my bedroom as I get ready for to bed and it’s become a sort of cue to my body that it’s time to relax. My apartment faces a busy road, so during the day the traffic noise is loud. I’ll put on headphones and listen to Ambiance, which offers a much more relaxing environment.
Just one thing though, in the Morning Espresso track, the guy keeps saying “I’m sorry I’m too loud” over and over again. It’s an interesting choice in sound clip to repeat over and over. 
Thanks for the overall nice and free app!

reviews.text:
Free, No Ads & it really works without a Subscription. I hate when I find an app that says “free” w/in app purchases just to find out it’s a “free trial” with a mandatory Subscription.
OR if they are free, you have to deal with Ad interruptions

NOT AMBIANCE!!! Downloaded the app, downloaded the sounds I liked and that night used it for 6 hours straight, NO INTERRUPTIONS!
AND NOT FORCED TO HAVE A TRIAL AKA SUBSCRIPTION!

I am a big believer in sound & vibration therapy plus I suffer from insomnia. 
Falling asleep to the tv has worked but THIS APP OMG!! 

*In my experience*
Literally it starts putting me in a meditative state, then a cathartic release (literal tears have streamed down my face peacefully), my over stimulated synapses become calm & have the most relaxing sleep ever. I wake up refreshed and lightened from any stress/anguish in my life. 

I love the different themes & color noises. Personally the “Night Orchestra” is my favorite, the crickets lightly chirping especially. (If you’ve ever seen the FX show “Legion” you may know what I mean). 

I’ve already recommended this app to everyone I know and so far only good things from them!

I hope the app keeps working as it is (no ads or glitches) and i truly hope a subscription plan will not be needed to use the basic features down the line. 

Thank you to the creators for making & providing such a fantastic app! 🙏🏼🖤

reviews.text: Excellent for studying, sleeping & work!. I’ve been using Ambiance for almost a year now and it the best focus app I have ever download! I discovered it from downloading Fabulous (which was also extremely useful) and checked the devs, blinked, and this wonderful app came to me! There are probably 50+ sounds to choose from, including the coloured noises and special categories they are organised in. My favourite is the ‘Journey Within’. No annoying ads in the middle of focusing and everything is absolutely free!
